dataset.name: Locally advanced rectal cancer (MSK, 2022)
dataset.description: Independent primary rectal-cancer cohort with bulk RNA-seq and linked overall- and disease-free-survival follow-up after neoadjuvant therapy.
dataset.cohort_context: Untreated primary rectal tumors from a clinically assembled cohort used to study response to neoadjuvant therapy. Endpoint time origins and treatment context differ from TCGA-READ and are retained explicitly.

metadata.curation_note: The public RNA expression sample list is joined to patient-level OS and DFS fields. Samples without a positive endpoint time and recognized event status are excluded deterministically.
metadata.scale_caveat: The cBioPortal profile describes RNA-seq expression but does not name its numerical unit or transformation. Negative supplied values rule out untransformed counts, TPM, FPKM or RPKM. TCGA-TRACE therefore preserves the supplied scale with identity transformation and makes no cross-study unit claim.

expression.label: Provided RNA-seq expression
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: Repeated rows with the same Entrez identifier are averaged sample-wise; distinct source identifiers are never merged implicitly.
expression.scale_note: Values are preserved exactly as supplied by the cBioPortal continuous RNA-seq profile because the source metadata does not identify the numerical transform.
